message: Hi, I'm a student with a shell programming certification background. My overall academic average is 74.8% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in programming and testing. I want to become a Applications Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 7100 per year. I live in Bengaluru. I cannot leave my city. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.
explanation:
This program in Software Quality Engineering directly aligns with your interest in testing and is located in Bengaluru. It has a low tuition cost ($1450) and offers a decent starting salary ($6488), making it a strong fit for an Applications Developer role focused on quality.

MSc Human-Computer Interaction is highly relevant to becoming an Applications Developer, focusing on the user experience aspect. It has a very low tuition cost ($900) and a good placement rate (77%), which addresses your priority of securing a good job.

This MTech Computer Science program offers 'software_engineering' and is located in Bengaluru with minimal tuition ($500). While the placement rate (62%) is lower than others, its core focus on software engineering makes it a solid technical choice for your career goal.

MSc Information Systems provides strong business context and is located in Bengaluru with low tuition ($1200). It boasts a high placement rate (78%) and a good starting salary ($9707), making it attractive if you want to blend development skills with business requirements.

MSc IT Operations is situated in Bengaluru and has a high median starting salary ($11419). While focused on 'it_support,' it offers strong job prospects within the tech industry and remains well within your budget.
